name: Bell
soul: The soul of someone who cannot keep a thing to themselves. They call out, and they are heard across a room.
spark: The mote hums. Put a cup over it and the cup rings.

hybrid.text: You hear it coming, and so does everyone who should.

settled.name: Hand-bell
settled.text: A small brass bell with a tongue it cannot keep still. It rings when you are late, when you are early, and when it is pleased.
settled.sign: A small brass bell whose tongue trembles just before anyone speaks.
settled.habit: It rings once, softly, when you come back into a room, whoever else is there.

paths.name: Rally-bell
paths.of: one who is only whole in company
paths.text: It learned from you that a table is not laid until everyone is at it.
paths.sign: It swings toward whichever of your friends is furthest off.
paths.habit: It rings people in to meals. It rings again, louder, for whoever is late.

prongs.name: Muster-bell
prongs.of: one who cannot start until everyone is here
prongs.text: It rings the party together before a door and apart again after, and has opinions about stragglers.
prongs.sign: A broad foot that it plants in doorways.
prongs.habit: It counts the party at every threshold with small taps on its own rim.

finishes.name: Convoy-bell
finishes.of: one who talks the whole way so that nobody feels the miles
finishes.text: It rings from the tender the whole way out. The passenger sleeps through it; nothing else does.
finishes.sign: A lamp hung under its lip that swings as it rings.
finishes.habit: It keeps up a soft steady ring on any long walk, and only stops to listen.

finishes.name: Roll-call
finishes.of: one who will not go on a head short
finishes.text: One stroke for each of you at every door. It will not stop at the wrong number.
finishes.sign: A strip of names pressed into its waist, and a mark by each.
finishes.habit: At dusk it rings each name it knows, and waits after each for an answer.

prongs.name: Mess-bell
prongs.of: one in whose company people put their burdens down
prongs.text: It is the sound of sitting down afterwards. People are a little mended just hearing it.
prongs.sign: A warm dull gold, with a dent where a ladle has struck it for years.
prongs.habit: It hums over anyone who is hurting, low, until they are breathing with it.

finishes.name: Mending-peal
finishes.of: one whose voice gets people back on their feet
finishes.text: It rings low when someone is hurt, and they stand up into the sound.
finishes.sign: A low ring you feel in the breastbone before you hear it.
finishes.habit: It rings under its breath near anything broken: a cup, a wrist, a mood.

finishes.name: Hearth-bell
finishes.of: one who says the names of the dead aloud
finishes.text: Hung by the hearth, it is rung for the dead by name. The shades come when it does.
finishes.sign: It hangs itself from any hook near a fire, and will not ring for trifles there.
finishes.habit: It rings once at nightfall for someone. It does not say who, and it is not always the same.

prongs.name: Change-ringer
prongs.of: one who needs others to keep time with
prongs.text: It has learned your chain as a peal, and rings each beat with you.
prongs.sign: A set of small wheels inside that turn it through its changes.
prongs.habit: It practises against any rhythm going, and will not stop in the middle of a run.

finishes.name: Peal of Eight
finishes.of: one who makes a thing longer and better by joining in
finishes.text: It rings your Pattern through with you, beat for beat, and the chain runs a beat longer for the company.
finishes.sign: Eight small bells have grown along its yoke, smallest to largest.
finishes.habit: It rings down the eight and back up, and is restless until someone claps the time.

finishes.name: The Tenor
finishes.of: one who speaks seldom, low, and last
finishes.text: One deep note, struck once, each time the oath is kept. You have come to need the sound.
finishes.sign: It has grown heavy and dark, with a rim as thick as a wrist.
finishes.habit: It keeps silent for days. When it does sound, people in other rooms look up.

paths.name: Hour-bell
paths.of: one whom others set their day by
paths.text: It learned from you that people can bear a great deal if they know what time it is.
paths.sign: It hangs dead level and rings on the hour, whatever hours you keep.
paths.habit: It rings you awake at the same moment every day, including the days you asked it not to.

prongs.name: Watch-bell
prongs.of: one who stays awake so that the night has a witness
prongs.text: It rings the hours through the night so the dark knows somebody is counting.
prongs.sign: A dark bronze that shows no shine at night.
prongs.habit: It rings the quarters through the night, quieter each time until dawn.

finishes.name: Curfew
finishes.of: one who can send everyone home with a word
finishes.text: When it tolls, things that hunt by dark remember somewhere else they have to be.
finishes.sign: One long note with a falling end, like a door closing slowly.
finishes.habit: At dusk it rings once and looks at anything still out of doors.

finishes.name: Post-bell
finishes.of: one who reports exactly what came, and no more
finishes.text: It hangs itself at the post you are holding and rings once for each thing that comes into the light.
finishes.sign: It hangs from a post's bracket as if the bracket had been made for it.
finishes.habit: It rings once for each thing that enters the light: a moth, a fox, you.

prongs.name: Tell-bell
prongs.of: one who hears the change in a voice before the words
prongs.text: It has learned what a strike sounds like before it is a strike.
prongs.sign: A wide flared lip, turned like an ear.
prongs.habit: It shivers, without sounding, a moment before any loud noise.

finishes.name: Strike-note
finishes.of: one who gives the cue and is never late with it
finishes.text: It sounds a breath before the blow lands. Parry on the note and you will not be late.
finishes.sign: A clean high note with no ring after it.
finishes.habit: It sounds a single note when you are about to drop something. You catch it.

finishes.name: Sounding-bell
finishes.of: one who asks a question and listens to how the answer comes back
finishes.text: Its echo comes back wrong off anything that is hiding. It rings, listens, and tells you where.
finishes.sign: It rings, then tilts, then waits. The waiting is most of it.
finishes.habit: It rings into wells, cupboards and empty rooms, and considers the echo.

prongs.name: Fog-bell
prongs.of: one who keeps on calling when they cannot see who hears
prongs.text: It rings so you can find it and so that other things think they have found you.
prongs.sign: Green at the rim, and beaded with wet in any weather.
prongs.habit: On still mornings it rings slowly, at intervals, toward the nearest water.

finishes.name: Channel-bell
finishes.of: one who has stood in one hard place for years, saying the same true thing
finishes.text: It rides a float in the bad water and rings the safe line. River towns have asked to keep it.
finishes.sign: It rides a float, tilting with a swell that is not there.
finishes.habit: It rings a little on every seventh breath, like a buoy in a slow sea.

finishes.name: Lost-bell
finishes.of: one whose voice seems to come from somewhere they are not
finishes.text: It rings from where you are not, and that is where the blow goes.
finishes.sign: You hear it from the wrong side. Every time.
finishes.habit: It rings from behind you, and then is in front of you, looking innocent.

paths.name: Alarm-bell
paths.of: one who says the hard thing aloud and will not take it back
paths.text: It learned from you that some things have to be said once, loudly, and stood by.
paths.sign: A hard bright note that people flinch from and then obey.
paths.habit: It rings at lies. Small ones too. It has made supper difficult.

prongs.name: Stun-bell
prongs.of: one who says it to your face, from very near
prongs.text: It goes in close and rings itself against the foe's skull.
prongs.sign: A thick-waisted bell, dented outward from the inside.
prongs.habit: It bumps against you when it wants attention, and rings on contact.

finishes.name: Anvil-bell
finishes.of: one who is only made louder by being struck
finishes.text: Strike it and the blow rings back up the arm that struck. It has been hit a great deal and enjoys it.
finishes.sign: Hammer marks all over it. It shows them off.
finishes.habit: It leans into anything that knocks it and hums afterwards, pleased.

finishes.name: Skull-ringer
finishes.of: one whose single remark ends the conversation
finishes.text: One stroke at arm's length. The foe stands very still afterwards, working out which way is up.
finishes.sign: A short heavy clapper, and a brow of bronze above the lip.
finishes.habit: It taps its clapper once against its own rim, thinking, like a knuckle on a table.

prongs.name: Carrying-bell
prongs.text: It has found the note that goes a long way and arrives still angry.
prongs.sign: A long narrow waist and a mouth pointed at the horizon.
prongs.habit: It rings across valleys to hear what comes back, and is put out if nothing does.

finishes.name: Far-caller
finishes.of: one who can be heard by the person they mean, a long way off
finishes.text: It grew a throat and a flare of brass and became a horn. What it calls at, across a valley, turns to look.
finishes.sign: It has grown a throat and a flare of brass. It is a horn now and knows it.
finishes.habit: From any height at evening it sounds one long call. Something far off always answers.

finishes.name: Thunder-bell
finishes.of: one whose mood changes the weather in the room
finishes.text: Your element is in the bronze. When it rings there is weather.
finishes.sign: The bronze has gone storm-coloured, and the air round it is close.
finishes.habit: It hums before rain. Your hair lifts a little when it does.

prongs.name: Binding-bell
prongs.of: one who knows what to call a thing so that it stops
prongs.text: A thing that hears its own toll does not move easily. It has learned whose toll is whose.
prongs.sign: A ring of small links round its crown, each one stamped.
prongs.habit: It tries out names under its breath, one after another, on anything it does not know.

finishes.name: Name-bell
finishes.of: one who learns the one thing each enemy cannot bear to hear
finishes.text: It has found the one note each named beast cannot bear, and keeps them all. It rings the right one first.
finishes.sign: A row of different small tongues inside it, and it chooses among them.
finishes.habit: It rings each of its notes in turn, softly, checking that none has been forgotten.

finishes.name: Passing-bell
finishes.of: one who tells you plainly that it is over
finishes.text: It rings once for what you are hunting. It is not a warning.
finishes.sign: One cold note, struck once. It does not repeat itself.
finishes.habit: It rings once when something nearby ends: a moth, a fire, a day.
